d: Long, flowing ash-grey hair with straight bangs falls over a youthful, mature face with sharp, crimson eyes. The slender build is dressed in a white short-sleeved button-up shirt with a purple tie, a short pleated black skirt, and one black thigh-high sock paired with white bandages wrapped around the other leg. Accessories include a black choker, black fingerless gloves, a tactical belt with red pouches, multiple black thigh holsters containing handguns, and a silver chain draped from the left wrist.
